name: The Sundarbans
description: The Sundarbans is a vast mangrove forest in southwestern Bangladesh, where the Ganges, Brahmaputra and Meghna rivers meet the Bay of Bengal. Tidal channels, mudflats and small islands weave through the salt-tolerant trees, and the forest continues across the border into India. It is home to Bengal tigers, estuarine crocodiles, Indian pythons and some 260 bird species.
